quotes.text: With a preliminary dataset from AgriCycle, a preliminary simulation model was developed to demonstrate the practical application of the DT framework in a commercial context.
quotes.section: 3.2 Pilot Study Implementation with AgriCycle Innovation Ltd

quotes.text: the main goal was to create a comprehensive DT simulation model to optimize productivity, yield, and resource efficiency in the mushroom waste supply chain.
quotes.section: 3.2 Pilot Study Implementation with AgriCycle Innovation Ltd

quotes.text: six key stages in the mushroom waste bio-conversion workflow were identified: mushroom cultivation and SMS collection, controlled transport, bioprocessing with yeasts and microorganisms, twin screw processing, board formation via pressing, and quality testing.
quotes.section: 3.2 Pilot Study Implementation with AgriCycle Innovation Ltd (see also Table 1, row 'Collection and Transport')

quotes.text: The conceptual simulation model represents the entire SMS conversion ecosystem, including supply chain partners, environmental monitoring systems, the processing system, quality control mechanisms, and feedback loops for continuous improvement.
quotes.section: 3.2 Pilot Study Implementation with AgriCycle Innovation Ltd

quotes.text: the process optimization stage implements machine-learning testing within the DT environment to proactively adjust operational parameters.
However, this optimization phase remains at the conceptual level due to limited data availability.
quotes.section: 3.2 Pilot Study Implementation with AgriCycle Innovation Ltd
